    55→/// @notice Repay flash loan to market
    56→/// @dev This is the only method to repay flash loan, consume the flash loan hot potato object
    57→/// @param version The version control object, contract version must match with this
    58→/// @param market The market object, it contains base assets, and related protocol configs
    59→/// @param coin The coin object to repay
    60→/// @param loan The flash loan hot potato object, which contains the borrowed amount and fee
    61→/// @ctx The SUI transaction context object
    62→/// @custom:T The type of asset to repay
    63→public fun repay_flash_loan<MarketType, CoinType>(
    64→    app: &mut ProtocolApp,
    65→    market: &mut Market<MarketType>,
    66→
    67→    coin: Coin<CoinType>,
    68→    loan: FlashLoan<MarketType, CoinType>,
    69→
    70→    ctx: &mut TxContext,
    71→) {
    72→    app.ensure_version_matches();
    73→    app.validate_market<MarketType>(market);
    74→
    75→    // Emit the repay flash loan event
    76→    emit(RepayFlashLoanEvent {
    77→        market: type_name::with_defining_ids<MarketType>(),
    78→        borrower: ctx.sender(),
    79→        asset: type_name::with_defining_ids<CoinType>(),
    80→        // amount is total repay coin amount
    81→        amount: coin.value(),
    82→        fee: loan.fee(),
    83→    });
    84→
    85→    let referral = app.referral_mut();
    86→    // Put the asset back to the market and consume the flash loan hot potato object
    87→    market.repay_flash_loan(coin, loan, referral, std::option::none(), ctx);
    88→}
